page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top, with the page number at the top left. No margin notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: num Tu perficias, cùm Facultatem Deus de-derit; multa palam tuli Me facturum, plura facere volebam, si Tempora fuissent secun-diora.

Fraus ista statim evanescet, & persona passim dilabetur. Nec iste fucus & larva Religionis (quâ se hactenus texit Rebellio) amplius horum turpitudinem & dehonestamenta velabit: Satis enim haec mea detentio, & inhuma-na tractatio demonstrant quàm sint de Me hi homines (quod ita valdè simulabant) sol-liciti.
Fœliciora Te (ut spero) exspectant Tempora; cùm calamitate sua edocti Subditi idjam[?] verum repererint, pietatem in Deum & in Re-gem Fidem haud posse sine peccato & miseria divelli.
Deus Tibi benedicat, & in Justitia Regna, in Vera Religione animam, in amore Dei & affectu Populi tui Honorem tuum semper stabiliat.

Sin Ille meo interitu consummandam hanc eorum perfidiam voluerit, sit memoria Mei & nomen in Te usque superstes, ut Patris Tui Amantissimi, & trium Florentissimorum Regnorum Regis, quem Deo ornare placuerat non Sceptro solium & Imperio, sed ea porro dignitate, ut plurimas contumelias Ipsius causa perpessus immatura tandem morte raperer, dum illud unice studuerim ut Jura Ecclesiae, vim Legum, Privilegia Parlamentorum & Libertates Populi conservarem, & Conscientiam Meam,

page.notes: Line-end words "de-derit", "secun-diora", "Re-gem", "inhuma-na" and "sol-liciti" keep their printed hyphens. "idjam" may be "id jam" with a missing space; kept as printed and marked [?]. "turpitudi nem" is printed with a space and is written whole. Long s is normalised to s throughout, and "Iuftitia" is given as "Justitia" (consonant J). The Greek running head reads ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ as printed; the final letters are somewhat uncertain. Italic is read from the scan for pietatem, Fidem, peccato, miseria, Patris, Regis, dignitate, Ecclesiae, Legum, Libertates and Conscientiam; the italic on Fidem and Regis is less certain. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
